body-app.purpose: Body text and inputs inside apps, launcher search (--text-md).

mono.purpose: Paths, URLs, versions, code and keyboard shortcuts only.

shadows.name: shadow-md

motion.purpose: Moves and resizes; window snap animation (220ms).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action per view; Interactive Blue with white text.
components.css: .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;height:32px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;font:500 13px/1.5 Inter,"Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:default;transition:background 80ms linear,border-color 80ms linear,transform 80ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);} .ds-btn-primary{background:var(--accent, #1f5ae6);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(14 16 20 / 0.08),0 1px 1px rgb(14 16 20 / 0.04);} .ds-btn-primary:hover{background:var(--accent-hover, #1747bd);} .ds-btn-primary:active{background:var(--accent-pressed, #12378f);transform:translateY(0.5px);box-shadow:none;} .ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring, #2f6bff);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Secondary actions: surface-1 with a hairline border and small shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-default{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;height:32px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--border-default, rgb(21 24 30 / 0.14));border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface-1, #ffffff);color:var(--text-primary, #15181e);font:500 13px/1.5 Inter,"Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(14 16 20 / 0.08),0 1px 1px rgb(14 16 20 / 0.04);cursor:default;transition:background 80ms linear;} .ds-btn-default:hover{background:var(--surface-3, #e6e9ee);} .ds-btn-default:active{background:var(--surface-3, #e6e9ee);box-shadow:none;transform:translateY(0.5px);} .ds-btn-default:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring, #2f6bff);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Toolbar and low-emphasis actions; no border or shadow until hover.

components.name: Search Input
components.description: 32px field with leading search icon; focus shifts the border to the ring colour with a 3px selection halo.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg class="ds-search-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="10.5" cy="10.5" r="6"/><path d="M15 15l5 5"/></svg><input class="ds-input" placeholder="Search apps and settings"></label>
components.css: .ds-search{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;width:280px;} .ds-search-icon{position:absolute;left:10px;color:var(--text-tertiary, #5f6878);pointer-events:none;} .ds-input{width:100%;height:32px;padding:0 12px 0 34px;border:1px solid var(--border-default, rgb(21 24 30 / 0.14));border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface-1, #ffffff);color:var(--text-primary, #15181e);font:400 13px/1.5 Inter,"Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;transition:border-color 80ms linear,box-shadow 80ms linear;} .ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--text-tertiary, #5f6878);} .ds-input:hover{border-color:var(--border-strong, rgb(21 24 30 / 0.28));} .ds-input:focus-visible{outline:none;border-color:var(--focus-ring, #2f6bff);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--selection-bg, rgb(47 107 255 / 0.18));}

components.name: Context Menu
components.description: Raised menu; hovered, focused or keyboard-active item fills Interactive Blue.
components.css: .ds-menu{display:grid;gap:1px;min-width:220px;padding:4px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface-raised, #ffffff);border:1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgb(21 24 30 / 0.08));box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgb(14 16 20 / 0.16),0 2px 8px rgb(14 16 20 / 0.08);font:400 13px/1.5 Inter,"Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;} .ds-menu-item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:16px 1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:28px;padding:0 8px;border:0;border-radius:5px;background:none;color:var(--text-primary, #15181e);font:inherit;text-align:left;cursor:default;} .ds-menu-item kbd{font:400 12px Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--text-tertiary, #5f6878);} .ds-menu-item:hover,.ds-menu-item:focus-visible{background:var(--accent, #1f5ae6);color:#fff;outline:none;} .ds-menu-item:hover kbd,.ds-menu-item:focus-visible kbd{color:inherit;opacity:0.85;} .ds-menu-sep{height:1px;margin:4px 8px;background:var(--divider, rgb(21 24 30 / 0.08));}

components.name: Accent Badge
components.description: Status and tag pill; accent, success, warning and danger tints share the shape.

components.name: Window (Dock style)
components.description: Focused window frame with 38px title bar, centred title and left traffic-light controls whose glyphs appear on hover.
components.html: VectorCraft
components.css: .ds-window{width:360px;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface-0, #f8f9fb);box-shadow:0 22px 48px rgb(14 16 20 / 0.22),0 4px 12px rgb(14 16 20 / 0.10),0 0 0 1px rgb(14 16 20 / 0.10);font:400 13px/1.5 Inter,"Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;} .ds-titlebar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;height:38px;padding:0 8px;background:var(--chrome-titlebar, #f1f3f6);border-bottom:1px solid var(--divider, rgb(21 24 30 / 0.08));} .ds-lights{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:0 6px;} .ds-light{width:13px;height:13px;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 10px/1 system-ui;color:transparent;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 0.5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.18);} .ds-lights:hover .ds-light,.ds-lights:focus-within .ds-light{color:rgb(0 0 0 / 0.55);} .ds-light:hover{filter:brightness(0.92);} .ds-light:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring, #2f6bff);outline-offset:2px;} .ds-close{background:#ff5f57;} .ds-min{background:#febc2e;} .ds-max{background:#28c840;} .ds-wtitle{flex:1;text-align:center;padding-right:60px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-primary, #15181e);} .ds-wbody{height:140px;background:var(--surface-0, #f8f9fb);}

components.name: Floating Dock
components.description: Dock style launcher bar: translucent pill with launcher first, app tiles that lift 4px on hover, 4px running dots.
components.css: .ds-dock{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;height:64px;padding:0 6px;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgb(21 24 30 / 0.08));background:var(--chrome-bar, rgb(248 249 251 / 0.78));backdrop-filter:saturate(1.6) blur(24px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:saturate(1.6) blur(24px);box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgb(14 16 20 / 0.16),0 2px 8px rgb(14 16 20 / 0.08);} .ds-dock-app{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;width:52px;height:56px;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:none;cursor:default;transition:transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);} .ds-dock-app:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);} .ds-dock-app:active{transform:translateY(-2px) scale(0.96);} .ds-dock-app:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring, #2f6bff);outline-offset:2px;} .ds-tile{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:10.9px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.10);filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.2));} .ds-dock-app i{display:none;position:absolute;bottom:0;left:50%;width:4px;height:4px;margin-left:-2px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--text-primary, #15181e);} .ds-dock-app[data-running] i{display:block;} .ds-dock-sep{width:1px;align-self:stretch;margin:8px 4px;background:var(--border-default, rgb(21 24 30 / 0.14));} @media (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce){.ds-dock{background:var(--chrome-bar-solid, #f8f9fb);backdrop-filter:none;-webkit-backdrop-filter:none;}}

components.name: Quick Settings Tile
components.description: Two-line toggle tile; pressed state fills Interactive Blue.
components.css: .ds-qs{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;width:160px;padding:10px;border:0;border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface-3, #e6e9ee);color:var(--text-primary, #15181e);text-align:left;font:400 12px/1.3 Inter,"Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:default;} .ds-qs b{display:block;font-weight:600;} .ds-qs small{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-secondary, #5a6373);} .ds-qs-icon{flex:none;width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--surface-1, #ffffff);} .ds-qs[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--accent, #1f5ae6);color:#fff;} .ds-qs[aria-pressed="true"] small{color:rgb(255 255 255 / 0.85);} .ds-qs[aria-pressed="true"] .ds-qs-icon{background:rgb(255 255 255 / 0.2);} .ds-qs:hover{filter:brightness(0.97);} .ds-qs:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring, #2f6bff);outline-offset:2px;}

narrative.overview:
JAT OS is a desktop environment at the craft level of the flagship operating systems, not a novelty web-desktop. The direction is the category standard executed straight: cool neutral greys, one blue accent, a quiet UI sans, crisp window chrome, soft layered shadows, and translucency only where it earns its place (bars, dock, menus over wallpaper). The user chose this over the assigned "Swatch Standard" direction and a "Transit Standard" pick (seed `4693b33a`, degraded roll, no challengers). Originality comes from the system and the brand mark, not from styling tricks.

One token set and one component library are expressed through four live-switchable shell styles: **Dock** (default), **Taskbar**, **Shelf** and **Activities**. Styles change only geometry and placement (bar position and height, control side and shape, window and panel radius). Colour, type, spacing, shadow and motion are shared. Every control works or is labelled as a concept.

Density is desktop-dense (13px default UI text, 32px controls) and relaxes on touch (44px targets under `pointer: coarse`). The shell renders inside a shadow root (`<jat-os>`), so it never touches the host WordPress theme and the theme never reaches in.
keyCharacteristics: Cool slate neutrals plus a single JAT Blue accent; status colours only for status.
Inter for all UI, tabular numerals for clocks and numbers; JetBrains Mono only for paths, versions and shortcuts.
Flat surfaces inside windows; depth comes from window, menu and dock shadows.
Translucent chrome with a solid fallback, honouring `prefers-reduced-transparency` and a user toggle.
One system, four shell styles, three form factors (phone, tablet, desktop).
Authored SVG art throughout: logo, app tiles, icons, wallpapers.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Interactive state is always JAT Blue. No second accent, no gradients on UI, no glow.

rules.name: The Tile-Only Rule
rules.body: App identity colours live on icon tiles and nowhere else. They never mark state, selection or category in the UI.

rules.name: The Tertiary Floor Rule
rules.body: Light tertiary text is `#5f6878`, not the slate-500 step, because it must hold 4.6:1 on surface-3 and 5.0:1 on surface-2. Do not "lighten" it.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Machines Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono appears only for paths, URLs, versions, code and keyboard shortcuts, at 0.92em. Never for headings or labels.

rules.name: The No-Caps Rule
rules.body: Labels are sentence case. `--tracking-caps` exists in tokens but no shipped surface uses uppercase labels.

rules.name: The Float-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows mark things that float (windows, menus, panels, dock, toasts). Content inside a window stays flat and tonal.

rules.name: The Solid Fallback Rule
rules.body: Every translucent surface has a solid equivalent that the user and the OS preference can force. Translucency never carries meaning.

dos: Do take every value from `assets/tokens.css` custom properties; update `tokens.json` in the same change.
Do express a new shell variation through the shell-style tokens (`--window-radius`, `--titlebar-height`, `--menu-radius`, `--panel-radius`, bar heights) rather than new colours or type.
Do use Interactive Blue (`#1f5ae6`) for fills behind white text and JAT Blue (`#2f6bff`) for brand, focus and selection.
Do give every translucent bar a solid fallback and respect `prefers-reduced-transparency`, `prefers-reduced-motion` and the in-app Reduce transparency toggle.
Do keep the shell inside its shadow root and ship styles as `tokens.css` → `components.css` → `shell.css`.
Do design each form factor on its own terms: full-screen apps on phone, maximised windows on tablet, free windows on desktop; 44px targets on coarse pointers.
Do draw new art as original SVG to the icon grid (24px, 1.75 stroke) or the app-tile template (64 units, 14.5 radius).
Do record provenance for rasters: `assets/screens/*.jpg` are Playwright captures of the example; all SVG art (logo, app tiles, icons, wallpapers) was authored for this project.
donts: Don't use app identity colours for UI state, selection, categories or charts.
Don't add a second accent, gradients on UI surfaces, glowing borders or decorative glassmorphism; translucency is for bars, dock, menus and scrims only.
Don't lighten light-theme tertiary text below `#5f6878`.
Don't use Apple, Microsoft or Google names, logos or icons in any shell style.
Don't set uppercase labels or use mono for anything but paths, versions, code and shortcuts.
Don't add shadows to content inside windows; tone and dividers separate it.
Don't ship a control that does nothing; label concepts as concepts.
